appraisal_events.evidence: « Ah ! j'avais bien senti que vous étiez musicien, s'écria-t-elle. Je comprends, artiste comme vous êtes, que vous aimiez cela. C'est si beau ! »
appraisal_events.explanation: The dowager Mme de Cambremer effusively hails the narrator as a fellow musician and artist, staging him as the object of her ecstatic gratitude, though the narration's comic excess (salivation, Latude, Fidelio comparisons) frames the scene satirically.

appraisal_events.evidence: elle fit son éloge avec tant de chaleur qu'on aurait pu croire qu'elle était amoureuse de lui ... « Il a une jolie qualité d'esprit »
appraisal_events.explanation: Mme de Cambremer praises Saint-Loup's wit with conspicuous warmth, but the narrator frames this admiration as instrumental — a device meant to be relayed back to Saint-Loup and to pivot toward name-dropping the duchesse de Guermantes — undercutting its sincerity.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator becomes the focus of the dowager's intense gratitude and admiration, gaining momentary emotional leverage as a valued interlocutor in the staged scene.
Saint-Loup receives warm, if instrumentalized, praise for his wit from Mme de Cambremer, giving him a modest local boost in esteem.
